name: pi
description: Delegates to the pi CLI in an isolated pi session. Use for work you want done by pi's model and tools rather than Claude's - a second opinion from another provider, or a cheap bulk pass. Runs pi's own read/bash/edit/write tools, so it can change files. To choose pi's model, make the prompt's first line `pi-model: <pattern>` (e.g. `pi-model: openrouter/moonshotai/kimi-k2`); the pattern is anything `pi --model` accepts, `pi --list-models <search>` lists them, and the provider/id form avoids ambiguity. files.content:
// Run with: claude plugin test integrations/rex-tty
import { describe, expect, test } from 'claude-code/testing'
import { gitFromSubcommand, quoted, unwrap, banner, blockOf, clamp, compile, needsTerminal, paneOutput, saysNoTerminal, segments, shellFor, side, strings, waited, words } from '../hooks/detect.ts'

describe('needsTerminal', () => {
  const yes = [
    'sudo apt install jq',
    'cd /tmp && sudo -u postgres psql',
    'FOO=1 sudo make install',
    'echo ok; /usr/bin/sudo true',
    'gh auth login',
    'gh auth refresh -s project',
    'git rebase -i HEAD~3',
    'git rebase --interactive main',
    'git add -p',
    'git stash --patch',
    'git commit',
    'git commit --amend',
    'npm login',
    'docker login ghcr.io -u me',
    'gcloud auth login',
    'aws sso login --profile dev',
    'ssh-add ~/.ssh/id_ed25519',
    'ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f key',
    'su - deploy',
    'wrangler login',
    'git -C repo rebase -i HEAD~2',
    'git -c core.editor=vim commit',
    'env FOO=1 sudo ls',
    'timeout 5 sudo ls',
    'command sudo ls',
    'env -u FOO sudo make install',
    'nice -n 5 sudo ls',
    'timeout -k 5 10 sudo ls',
    'cd /srv && \\\n  sudo systemctl restart app',
    'echo ok && \\\nsudo ls',
    'git --no-pager -C repo commit',
  ]
  for (const c of yes) test(`sends: ${c}`, () => expect(needsTerminal(c)).not.toBe(null))

  const no = [
    'ls -la',
    'sudo -n true',
    'sudo -nE env',
    'echo secret | sudo -S whoami',
    'echo "run sudo make install later"',
    "grep -r 'git commit' docs",
    'gh auth status',
    'gh auth login --with-token < token.txt',
    'git rebase main',
    'git rebase --continue',
    'GIT_SEQUENCE_EDITOR=true git rebase -i HEAD~2',
    'git commit -m "fix: a thing"',
    'git commit -am wip',
    'git commit --amend --no-edit',
    'git commit -m "$(cat <<EOF\nsubject (scope)\nEOF\n)"',
    'git add -A',
    'docker login -u me --password-stdin',
    'npm install',
    'ssh-add -l',
    'ssh-keygen -t ed25519 -f key -N ""',
    'ssh-keygen -lf key.pub',
    'sudoku --solve',
    'constructor --help',
    'toString',
    '__proto__ x',
    'hasOwnProperty login',
    'sudo -u root -n ls',
    'cat <<EOF > notes.txt\nsudo apt install x\ngit commit\nEOF',
    'aws configure set region us-east-1',
    'az login --service-principal -u a -p b',
    'stripe login --api-key sk_x',
    'supabase login --token t',
    'git -C repo commit -m x',
    'git commit -C HEAD',
    'git commit -C HEAD~1 --no-edit',
    "cat <<'END-OF.FILE' > notes.txt\nsudo apt install x\nEND-OF.FILE",
    'cat <<"my eof"\nsudo ls\nmy eof',
    'cat <<-EOF\n\tsudo ls\n\tEOF',
    'echo a \\\n  b',
    '',
  ]
  for (const c of no) test(`leaves: ${c || '(empty)'}`, () => expect(needsTerminal(c)).toBe(null))

  test('extra patterns add, skip patterns win', () => {
    expect(needsTerminal('mytool deploy', [/^mytool deploy/])).not.toBe(null)
    expect(needsTerminal('sudo ls', [], [/^sudo ls$/])).toBe(null)
  })
})

describe('what the person is shown', () => {
  test('control characters never reach the question or the banner', () => {
    expect(banner('echo a\u001b[2K\u001b[1Gls')).toBe('rex-tty ▸ echo a[2K[1Gls')
    expect(quoted('a\u0007b\nc')).toBe('ab\nc')
  })
  test('a long command is shown to its limit, with what is left out', () => {
    const q = quoted('x'.repeat(20) + '\ny', 10)
    expect(q.startsWith('x'.repeat(10) + '\n… (12 more characters, 2 lines in all')).toBe(true)
  })
  test('wrappers are looked through', () => {
    expect(unwrap(['env', '-i', 'A=1', 'nohup', 'sudo', 'ls'])).toEqual(['sudo', 'ls'])
    expect(unwrap(['timeout', '5', 'sudo', 'ls'])).toEqual(['sudo', 'ls'])
    expect(unwrap(['timeout', '-k', '5', '10', 'sudo'])).toEqual(['sudo'])
    expect(unwrap(['env', '-u', 'FOO', '--', 'sudo'])).toEqual(['sudo'])
    expect(unwrap(['/usr/bin/nice', '-n', '5', 'ls'])).toEqual(['ls'])
  })
  test('git global options go, the subcommand keeps its own', () => {
    expect(gitFromSubcommand(['-C', 'repo', '--no-pager', 'commit', '-C', 'HEAD'])).toEqual(['commit', '-C', 'HEAD'])
    expect(gitFromSubcommand(['status'])).toEqual(['status'])
  })
})

describe('shell parsing', () => {
  test('segments split at operators outside quotes', () => {
    expect(segments('a && b; c | d')).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'])
    expect(segments('echo "a; b" && c')).toEqual(['echo "a; b"', 'c'])
    expect(segments('a && \\\n  b')).toEqual(['a', 'b'])
    expect(segments('cat <<X\nsudo ls\nX\necho done')).toEqual(['cat <<HEREDOC', 'echo done'])
  })
  test('words drop assignments and quotes', () => {
    expect(words('A=1 B=2 cmd "x y" z')).toEqual({ assignments: ['A=1', 'B=2'], argv: ['cmd', 'x y', 'z'] })
  })
})

describe('options', () => {
  test('lists, patterns, numbers and sides', () => {
    expect(strings('a, b,,')).toEqual(['a', 'b'])
    expect(compile(['^ok$', '(']).bad).toEqual(['('])
    expect(clamp('40', 10, 90, 35)).toBe(40)
    expect(clamp(500, 10, 90, 35)).toBe(90)
    expect(clamp('x', 10, 90, 35)).toBe(35)
    expect(side('left')).toBe('left')
    expect(side('diagonal')).toBe('below')
    expect(shellFor('/bin/zsh')).toBe('/bin/zsh')
    expect(shellFor('/opt/homebrew/bin/fish')).toBe('/bin/bash')
    expect(shellFor(undefined)).toBe('/bin/bash')
  })
})

describe('rex output', () => {
  test('the block id of a split', () => {
    expect(blockOf('{"anchor_id":"block:a","block_ids":["block:b"],"revision":2}')).toBe('block:b')
    expect(blockOf('Error: nope')).toBe(null)
    expect(blockOf('{"block_ids":[]}')).toBe(null)
  })
  test('how a wait ended', () => {
    expect(waited('{"exit_code":7,"error":"exit status 7"}\n', 'Error: exit status 7\n')).toEqual({ kind: 'exit', code: 7 })
    expect(waited('{"exit_code":0}\n', '')).toEqual({ kind: 'exit', code: 0 })
    expect(waited('', 'Error: wait timed out after 2s: context deadline exceeded\n')).toEqual({ kind: 'timeout' })
    expect(waited('', 'Error: block target "x" not found\n')).toEqual({ kind: 'gone', detail: 'Error: block target "x" not found' })
  })
  test('the pane text loses the banner and keeps the tail', () => {
    const head = banner('sudo  make\ninstall')
    expect(head).toBe('rex-tty ▸ sudo make install')
    expect(paneOutput(`${head}\n\nPassword:\ninstalled\n\n`, head)).toBe('Password:\ninstalled')
    expect(paneOutput('no banner here\n', head)).toBe('no banner here')
    const long = paneOutput(`${head}\n\n${'x'.repeat(50)}`, head, 10)
    expect(long.endsWith('x'.repeat(10))).toBe(true)
    expect(long.startsWith('[… 40 earlier')).toBe(true)
  })
  test('a no-terminal failure is recognised', () => {
    expect(saysNoTerminal('sudo: a terminal is required to read the password')).toBe(true)
    expect(saysNoTerminal('error: cannot prompt because user interactivity has been disabled')).toBe(true)

// Run with: claude plugin test ui/agent-flow
import { describe, expect, test } from 'claude-code/testing'
import type { Engine } from 'claude-code/testing'
import type { On } from 'claude-code'
import {
  MAIN,
  bar,
  completed,
  counts,
  createFlow,
  excerpt,
  fmtTokens,
  rows,
  spawned,
  stepped,
  synced,
  toolLabel,
  toolRan,
  trimmed,
} from '../hooks/flow.ts'

const usage = (input: number, cached = 0, output = 10) => ({
  input_tokens: input,
  output_tokens: output,
  cache_read_input_tokens: cached,
  cache_creation_input_tokens: 0,
})

const spawn = (agentId: string, parentAgentId?: string, extra = {}) => ({
  agentId,
  parentAgentId,
  description: `task ${agentId}`,
  subagentType: 'Explore',
  prompt: 'Find where auth tokens are refreshed.\nReport file paths.',
  fork: false,
  background: false,
  ...extra,
})

describe('flow.ts', () => {
  test('spawns build a tree in spawn order, nested by parent', () => {
    const flow = createFlow()
    spawned(flow, spawn('a'), 1)
    spawned(flow, spawn('b', 'a'), 2)
    spawned(flow, spawn('c'), 3)
    spawned(flow, spawn('d', 'unknown-parent'), 4)
    const r = rows(flow)
    expect(r.map(x => x.node.id)).toEqual(['a', 'b', 'c', 'd'])
    expect(r.map(x => x.prefix)).toEqual(['├─', '│ └─', '├─', '└─'])
    expect(flow.nodes.get('d')?.parentId).toBe(MAIN)
  })

  test('steps, tools and completion fill in what each loop did', () => {
    const flow = createFlow()
    spawned(flow, spawn('a'), 1)
    stepped(flow, 'a', usage(1000, 4000, 50), 2)
    stepped(flow, 'a', usage(500, 2000, 30), 3)
    for (let i = 0; i < 10; i++) toolRan(flow, 'a', { tool: 'Read', label: `f${i}.ts` }, 4)
    completed(flow, 'a', { answer: 'Found it in src/auth.ts', reason: 'answer', durationMs: 3200 }, 5)
    const a = flow.nodes.get('a')!
    expect(a.steps).toBe(2)
    expect(a.contextTokens).toBe(2500)
    expect(a.peakContext).toBe(5000)
    expect(a.outputTokens).toBe(80)
    expect(a.toolCount).toBe(10)
    expect(a.tools.length).toBe(8)
    expect(a.tools.at(-1)?.label).toBe('f9.ts')
    expect(a.status).toBe('done')
    expect(counts(flow)).toEqual({ running: 0, done: 1, failed: 0 })
  })

  test('a loop no spawn announced is still drawn, marked unlisted', () => {
    const flow = createFlow()
    stepped(flow, 'wf-1', usage(10), 1)
    expect(flow.nodes.get('wf-1')?.unlisted).toBe(true)
    stepped(flow, undefined, usage(20_000), 2)
    expect(flow.nodes.get(MAIN)?.contextTokens).toBe(20_000)
  })

  test('trim drops finished branches only, never one with a running agent', () => {
    const flow = createFlow()
    spawned(flow, spawn('a'), 1)
    spawned(flow, spawn('a1', 'a'), 1)
    spawned(flow, spawn('b'), 2)
    completed(flow, 'b', { answer: '', reason: 'answer', durationMs: 1 }, 3)
    completed(flow, 'a', { answer: '', reason: 'answer', durationMs: 1 }, 3)
    trimmed(flow, 0)
    expect([...flow.nodes.keys()].sort()).toEqual(['a', 'a1', 'main'])
  })

  test('a resume reopens the same node and keeps its task; an idle teammate is not left running', () => {
    const flow = createFlow()
    spawned(flow, spawn('a'), 1)
    spawned(flow, spawn('b', 'a'), 1)
    completed(flow, 'b', { answer: 'ok', reason: 'answer', durationMs: 1 }, 2)
    spawned(flow, spawn('b', undefined, { prompt: 'Also check the logout path.', resumed: true }), 3)
    const b = flow.nodes.get('b')!
    expect(b.status).toBe('running')
    expect(b.parentId).toBe('a')
    expect(b.prompt).toContain('auth tokens')
    expect(b.answer).toBeUndefined()
    expect(b.durationMs).toBeUndefined()
    spawned(flow, spawn('gone', undefined, { prompt: 'Keep going.', resumed: true }), 3)
    expect(flow.nodes.get('gone')?.prompt).toBe('(resumed) Keep going.')
    expect(flow.order.filter(id => id === 'b').length).toBe(1)

    spawned(flow, spawn('mate', undefined, { background: true }), 4)
    synced(flow, [{ id: 'mate', status: 'idle', type: 'Explore', description: 'task mate' }])
    expect(flow.nodes.get('mate')?.status).toBe('done')
    // an idle teammate is not trimmed away as finished
    trimmed(flow, 0)
    expect(flow.nodes.has('mate')).toBe(true)
    synced(flow, [{ id: 'b', status: 'waiting', type: 'Explore', description: 'task b' }])
    expect(flow.nodes.get('b')?.status).toBe('running')
    stepped(flow, 'mate', usage(10), 5)
    expect(flow.nodes.get('mate')?.status).toBe('running')
  })

  test('small helpers', () => {
    expect(fmtTokens(950)).toBe('950')
    expect(fmtTokens(12_345)).toBe('12.3k')
    expect(fmtTokens(250_000)).toBe('250k')
    expect(bar(50, 10)).toBe('█████░░░░░')
    expect(toolLabel('Bash', { command: 'git   status' })).toBe('git status')
    expect(toolLabel('Agent', { description: 'scan', prompt: 'long prompt' })).toBe('scan')
    expect(excerpt('a\n\nb\nc\nd', 2, 20)).toEqual(['a', 'b', '… 2 more lines'])
  })
})

function fakeEngine(on: On) {

      usage: { ...usage(e.agentId ? 3000 : 1000, e.agentId ? 9000 : 40_000), model: 'm' },

  on('tool.call', async () => ({ result: 'ok', text: 'ok' }) as never)
  on('turn.start', async ($, e) => ({ turnId: e.turnId }))
  on('turn.complete', async ($, e) => ({ text: e.answer }))
  on('agent.list', () => ({ value: [] }))
  on('session.usage', () => ({

        breakdown: { categories: [{ name: 'Messages', tokens: 30_000, color: 'x', isDeferred: false, kind: 'used' }] },

  }) as never)
  on('ui.open', () => ({ value: undefined }))
  on('ui.close', () => ({ value: undefined }))
  on('ui.status', () => ({ value: undefined }))
  on('ui.invalidate', () => ({ value: undefined }))

  for await (const _ of s) {

describe('the pane', () => {
  test('draws main, a subagent and a nested one, with context in and out', async ($, on) => {
    fakeEngine(on)
    const opened = await $.command.run({
      command: 'agent-flow',
      args: '',
      origin: { kind: 'composer' },
      presentation: { isFullscreen: true, columns: 200 },
    })
    expect(opened.text).toContain('agents so far')

    await $.turn.start({ text: 'refactor the auth module', turnId: 't1' })
    await drain($)
    const first = await $.agent.spawn({ prompt: 'Map the auth module.\nList every file.', description: 'map auth', subagentType: 'Explore' })
    expect(first.agentId).toBe('sub-1')
    await drain($, 'sub-1')
    await $.tool.call({ tool: 'Read', file_path: 'src/auth.ts', agentId: 'sub-1' } as never)
    await $.agent.spawn({ prompt: 'Check tests.', description: 'nested', subagentType: 'general-purpose', parentAgentId: 'sub-1' } as never)
    await $.turn.complete({ answer: 'auth lives in src/auth.ts and src/session.ts', durationMs: 4200, isAborted: false, turnId: 't1', agentId: 'sub-1', reason: 'answer' })

    const ui = await $.ui.mount({ plugin: 'agent-flow', surface: 'terminal', component: 'Pane', requestId: 'agent-flow', props: PANE_PROPS })
    expect(await ui.find({ key: 'ag:main' })).toBeDefined()
    expect((await ui.find({ key: 'ag:sub-1' }))?.text).toContain('map auth')
    expect((await ui.find({ key: 'ag:sub-2' }))?.text).toContain('nested')
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /1 running · 1 done/ })).toBeDefined()

    await ui.press({ key: 'ag:sub-1' })
    await ui.redraw()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /↓ in from main: prompt/ })).toBeDefined()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Map the auth module/ })).toBeDefined()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Read src\/auth\.ts/ })).toBeDefined()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /↑ out to main: answer/ })).toBeDefined()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /12\.0k/ })).toBeDefined()

    await ui.press({ key: 'ag:main' })
    await ui.redraw()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /2 subagents|1 subagents/ })).toBeDefined()
    // a subagent's turn (Claude Code 2.1.299+) never replaces the person's prompt on main
    await $.turn.start({ text: 'Map the auth module.', turnId: 't2', agentId: 'sub-1' })
    await ui.redraw()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /› refactor the auth module/ })).toBeDefined()
    expect(await ui.find({ type: 'Text', text: /Messages/ })).toBeDefined()
    await ui.unmount()
  })
})
